summary.text: Lucas Atkinson is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 57, who assumed office on November 14, 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
